comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record releases and removes an air-fryer basket onto a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-rail support, dual-prong alignment, telescoping, and screw use versus keyed button actuation, unhooking, and hot-surface avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Four retained prongs, level rack-unit registration, correct screws, and 3 s release versus basket placement/release with fingertip and hot-surface clearances.
comparison.reason: A shared release/tab primitive is generic; the record does not test staged load-bearing installation across separated posts.
